conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, prioritizing stability. Expect lower volatility and smaller drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while selectively adding high-quality tech names. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a reasonable growth outlook.

plan: Add to SOXL, targeting 6%, and SPAL, targeting 4%, to lean into leveraged ETF exposure for aggressive growth.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this approach amplifies both potential gains and losses, with higher expected volatility and larger drawdowns. Leveraged ETFs also experience daily decay and rebalancing effects.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, SMH, and CRWD to zero to eliminate leveraged ETFs and high-beta growth names.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It significantly reduces exposure to leverage and high-beta growth, favoring income-generating ETFs and broad market exposure. While aiming for reliable distributions and low drawdown, remember that distributions are variable and NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
